component.name: Dardasha
component.summary: Chat on WhatsApp Web with a system tray and desktop notifications

description.p: Dardasha is an independent desktop client for WhatsApp Web. It adds what a browser tab cannot: a system tray icon that shows unread messages, native desktop notifications, global shortcuts, media controls for voice notes, and starting hidden at login.
It also follows the desktop: its fonts and theme, correct direction for Arabic and other right-to-left text, a passcode lock and a privacy shield that keeps message text out of notifications.
It requires an existing WhatsApp account and an Internet connection. Dardasha is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.
